所有人数、工资、价格和税率均为教学假设，不代表真实企业或行业平均。: All headcounts, wages, prices and tax rates are teaching assumptions, not data for a real business or industry averages.

按日净额结算，银行补齐缺口，年息假设 8%；尾款到达后支付利息、税款和分红。未模: Payments net on each date; bank loans cover shortages at an assumed 8% annual rate. Interest, tax and dividends settle after final payment. Credit limits are not modelled.
收入扣面料、工资、雇主福利、运营、折旧、利息和所得税。福利假设为工资 20%，所: Revenue less materials, wages, employer benefits, operations, depreciation, interest and income tax. Benefits are assumed at 20% of wages; tax is 25% of positive pretax profit.
服务商还会支付自己的工资和供应商。这张图没有把它们再拆一遍。: Service firms also pay their staff and suppliers. These further payments are not expanded here.
条长 = 一个人的税前月薪: Bar length = one person’s gross monthly salary

楼属于公司资产，贷款属于负债。这里只做简单累计，不预测融资审批或扩产收益。: The building is a company asset; its loan is a liability. Simple accumulation does not predict credit approval or expansion returns.
老板兼任总经理，假设持股 80%。留存现金等于留存利润加回折旧；建楼另分自有资金: The owner also serves as director, with an assumed 80% stake. Retained cash is retained profit plus depreciation. Building funds are split between company funds and borrowing.
